paragraphs: He is mentioned at the end of Tosefta Shekalim, chapter 2, as the Temple official responsible for salt.[^1]

notes.text: The named Tosefta Shekalim chapter 2 text from Mechon Mamre explicitly lists Ben Maklit as responsible for salt among the Temple officials. Hyman’s end-of-chapter locator is retained; a precise modern subsection number is not substituted for it. The other officials and responsibilities in the selected paragraph are not added to this notice.
